test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following predictions made by certain scientists creates a larger threat of floods in India?

options.text: Heavy monsoon over a shorter period than usual

solution:
The correct answer is '**Heavy monsoon over a shorter period than usual**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about flooding, its impacts, and its effects in India.
 
• In the third paragraph of the passage, it has been stated - *'One set of scientists has estimated that the monsoons could be shorter in duration, but far more intensive. In other words, much greater precipitation would take place in a much shorter period of time, thereby increasing the danger of floods.' *
 
• Thus, we can conclude that the prediction made by certain scientists that creates a larger threat of floods in India is "**h**eavy monsoon over a shorter period than usual".
 
• This makes option 3 the correct answer.
